Registration & refund policy

✓
A two-week window to decide

If your registered course is not right for you, request a refund within the first 14 calendar days after the course begins.

How the refund works

  • The refund window begins on your confirmed course start date, not the date you register or pay.
  • For upfront payment, an eligible request refunds the full $1,800 paid for that course.
  • For the monthly plan, an eligible request refunds course installments already paid and cancels future installments.
  • Your enrollment ends when your refund and cancellation are processed.

Requesting a refund

Contact your course instructor within the 14-day window using the contact details supplied with your enrollment confirmation. Include your name, registration email, course name, and confirmed start date. Keep a copy of your request. The provider will review the registration and arrange the refund to the original payment method.

Refunds are processed by the course provider; they are not issued automatically by this website. The time for a refund to appear depends on the payment provider and your bank. For requests outside the two-week window, contact the instructor to discuss available options.

Payment options

Pay $1,800 USD upfront, saving $200 from the $2,000 course price, or choose four monthly payments of $500 USD. The monthly plan starts with a payment after card authorization, followed by three monthly payments. It ends after four billing periods. Failed payments may be retried and do not count as successful payments.

Course and schedule confirmation

Your preferred schedule is a request. Class availability, the confirmed start date, and the refund deadline will be provided with your enrollment arrangements. Each registration covers one selected course.

Your information

We use your name, email, phone, selected course, preferred schedule, consent, and payment references to administer enrollment and communicate about your course. When registration is activated, records are stored on the registration backend and copied into the provider's local SQL database. Stripe handles card information; the course database does not store card numbers.

Current registration status

Payments are not active yet. Registration-only submissions are available when the backend is connected; no charge is authorized or taken by a registration-only submission. Before enrollment opens, the provider will publish a direct contact email, data retention period, and privacy request process here.
